verdict.rationale: Baseten's Model APIs docs only showcase text/LLM capabilities (chat completions, function calling, structured outputs, streaming) with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, but Truss's general framework support explicitly includes 'diffusers' (image-generation models) and other frameworks like PyTorch/TensorFlow that could serve vision or audio models on dedicated infrastructure. There's no evidence of a curated hosted Model API catalog for vision/audio/image-gen analogous to the text chat APIs—only that custom deployment is technically possible. Missing for 10: explicit vision/audio model API examples, documented image-generation Model APIs, and any hands-on confirmation of multimodal inference beyond text.
